LIVE at pammytv2.github.io/Profile_dev/

Work list now shows only the three real projects. The type filter and TYPE column are gone — with one category left there was nothing to filter. Easy to add back when there are work projects.

STILL PLACEHOLDER, and visible on the live site:
· [COMPANY] — twice, in the hero and in about
· [YOUR MAIN STACK]
· the second about paragraph
· [WHAT YOU'RE PICKING UP NOW] — learning card
· [YOUR LINKEDIN URL] — the link is dead, as it was before
The accent colour is a tweak chip above each artboard — green, blue, amber or pink. Desktop and mobile are separate files, so change it on both.

A — MISSION CONTROL (not chosen)

Kept the space identity but disciplined it: near-black, a faint technical grid, monospace data labels, a telemetry strip.

B — EDITORIAL (not chosen)

Warm paper, serif headlines, work as big numbered entries with room to explain them.

C — TERMINAL (chosen)

This is the original sketch, kept for reference. The built-out version is on the Portfolio page.
